# R005: Quilon Formation depositional estimate

Carolin, Vadlamani and Bajpai report a preferred depositional estimate of 17.08–17.13 Ma for sampled Quilon Formation material, based on strontium-isotope work on molluscan shells.

**Evidence type:** `research_article_claim`  
**Geographic relation:** `core`  
**Places:** Quilon Formation; sample coordinates pending full-text review

## Limitations

The preferred range is not presented here as a statistical confidence interval or an age for the whole coastline. Sampled sections, sample count, reference curve and uncertainty were not seen; the full text is closed access. S008 shares authors and is not independent confirmation.
